Hi Kayla / Harbor AP team,

Hope you’re well. Invoice INV-8342 is currently on hold pending sales tax documentation. To release the invoice for payment we need either:

- A state-issued Direct Pay Permit that covers the purchases for the billing jurisdiction(s) listed on the invoice; or
- A valid resale certificate that specifically covers software/subscription services (if applicable) and lists Harbor Supply Co. as the purchaser.

What we need from you:
1) A scanned PDF of the Direct Pay Permit (or resale certificate) showing the permit ID and issuing state agency.
2) A short statement confirming the permit’s coverage (states covered, effective dates, and whether it applies to intangible/software services vs tangible goods).
3) Billing address and Harbor Tax ID (EIN) that matches the permit.

For speed, please attach the PDF to your reply or send via DocuSign link if you prefer. I’m attaching a short checklist with the required fields to make sure TaxOps can process it without extra back-and-forth.

If we don’t receive documentation by end of day Friday (5/21) we’ll need to apply sales tax to the invoice and keep it on hold. Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if that helps.

Thanks,

Thanks Kayla — that helps. A couple quick clarifications from TaxOps so we can close the hold: 

1) Please confirm whether the direct-pay permit will explicitly list Harbor Supply Co. (preferred) or if it is a corporate-level permit that covers multiple subsidiaries. If corporate-level, we need the exact legal entity name that the state permit covers.
2) Can you confirm that the permit covers software/saas/subscription purchases? Some TX permits exclude intangibles; TaxOps needs the explicit scope.
3) If you have the final permit number when issued, please reply with the PDF. If not, a notarized statement (signed by an authorized officer) confirming coverage for TX is acceptable for interim processing.

I’ve looped in Neha from Billing to expedite once we have the document. If you can send the final PDF or the notarized statement today or tomorrow, we should be able to clear the invoice the same day.

Thanks again — I’ll watch for the DocuSign or PDF.

Ben
